contract.rps_denominator: successful completions / elapsed including final drain
contract.ring_route_gate: Each node must show exact submitted and completed query-member deltas equal to 16 warmup requests plus successful timed queries; zero ring fallback and HNSW search calls.
contract.scope_limit: Only B64/C4 and B128/C4, four metadata categories, AVX-512 VNNI and Auto; native values are a previous-run reference and are not measured again.

ring_admission_proof.counter_semantics: Process-global per-node counters increment once for each query member submitted/completed; measured-row delta includes 16 warmup requests plus timed requests and final drain.
